nodes.name: Chat Trigger
nodes.notes: Embedded Chat. Copy the Chat URL from this node into ENGINEVERSE_ASSISTANT_URL (proxy) and/or ENGINEVERSE_ASSISTANT_PUBLIC_URL (static Pages copy).

nodes.name: Guard question
nodes.notes: Length bounds, control characters and a per-session budget of 20 questions/hour.

nodes.name: Allowed?
nodes.notes: A refused message never reaches the model.

nodes.name: Model (OpenAI-compatible)
nodes.notes: Point this at any OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions endpoint. The credential is an HTTP Header Auth credential holding Authorization: Bearer <your key> - never put the key in this node.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO assistant_events (occurred_at, session_ref, question_chars, answer_chars, model)
        VALUES (to_timestamp($1::double precision / 1000), $2, $3, $4, $5)

nodes.name: Log metadata (optional)
nodes.notes: Disabled by default. Enable only after creating the table (see n8n/README.md) and choosing a retention period. No question text is written.

parameters.jsCode:
const item = $json || {};
return [{ json: { output: item.output ?? "I could not answer that." } }];

nodes.name: Reply
nodes.notes: The last node's `output` is what n8n returns to the chat.

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { output: $json.refusal || "Ask a question of at least a few words." } }];

nodes.name: Refusal
nodes.notes: Terminal node for a message that failed validation.

meta.description: Chat Trigger → validate/limit → OpenAI-compatible model → reply. No LangChain node versions to match; point the HTTP node at any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
